subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should this PR's six-source internal-handoff drop rule be accepted as the canonical repair, or should `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759` remain the canonical fix path for the linked stale-reply issue?
rationale: Both PRs target the same stale-reply root cause but encode different session-state semantics, and the current PR lacks the real runtime proof required to settle the safer behavior automatically.

options.title: Prefer the proof-positive broader repair
options.body: Treat `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759` as the canonical path unless maintainers specifically want this narrower internal-drop behavior.

options.title: Continue this narrow drop PR
options.body: Keep this PR active but require redacted embedded-agent proof showing internal handoff text is dropped and `sessions_send` text is preserved before merge.

options.title: Request a narrower predicate
options.body: Ask the contributor to reduce the affected source-tool set if not all six internal handoffs should be removed from repaired prompts.

recommendation.title: Prefer the proof-positive broader repair
recommendation.body: Treat `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759` as the canonical path unless maintainers specifically want this narrower internal-drop behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation behavior introduced in PR 65478.
